why_it_matters.text: An anticonvulsant sold as Tegretol, used for epilepsy, trigeminal neuralgia and bipolar disorder.

approval.basis: Marketed today (prescription) under NDA 016608 in the Drugs@FDA data files.

description: An anticonvulsant sold as Tegretol, used for epilepsy, trigeminal neuralgia and bipolar disorder. Carbamazepine (C15H12N2O, 236 g/mol) is an anticonvulsant dispensed on prescription.

parts.label: The urea group
parts.sentence: A C=O with a nitrogen on each side, the same arrangement as in urea itself. Its N-H and C=O groups form hydrogen bonds readily.

parts.label: The ring system
parts.sentence: Rings joined where they share atoms, or a single ring standing alone. Atoms in a ring are held in place, so this part keeps its shape while chains around it can bend.
